summary: Remove the retired catalog supervisor and its restart/residency ownership

replay.detail: No graph event replay or native recovery path changes. The removed catalog supervisor has no current product entry point after root CLI retirement.

schema.detail: No database schema change and no deletion of existing catalog, park, task runtime or residency files.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, digests or all-member feature activation change.

compatibility.detail: Removes workspace-internal catalog Runner/PtyCli/SystemRunner, supervisor reports and loops, restart budget and catalog residency owner. No current CLI, daemon or native harness calls them. Existing host/state/process helper paths and catalog working-directory/socket calculations remain with identical implementations. The supervisor-only declaration/generation watcher and its launch/resource sampling adapters are removed; native delivery watches and their mutation filtering remain unchanged. Canonical Clippy measurement lowers only four removed diagnostics in the committed baseline; all other warning counts and the toolchain remain unchanged.

downtime.detail: No additional interruption; current native driver and runtime ownership paths remain.

manual.detail: No existing installation needs cleanup. Old supervisor state is left on disk; the native graph runtime and current migration tool remain available.

recovery.detail: No new store recovery or downgrade requirement. The removed code can be restored by reverting this source change; no persisted data is rewritten.
